scientific_integrity: All infinite-time assertions have an analytic proof; numerical checks corroborate rather than certify asymptotic limits. Prior reduced-propagator formulas and elementary Pell constructions are acknowledged; no external independent evaluation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Sharp liminf only for the continuous reduced cosine-wave propagator on an equal-mass equal-edge three-vertex path. No uniform joint finite-coupling/large-time statement for the original discrete Grover walk, and no assertion for asymmetric systems or longer paths.
title: A sharp time–fidelity law for three-community quantum-wave transfer
